description: Validated 10 Hz Vehicle CAN bus clock offsets against GNSS timebase (IO-VNBD dataset).

S-S4.reason: Split-clock CAN logging failure. Uncorrelated for the first 65 minutes (Pearson r in [-0.38, 0.15], MAE ~ 22 km/h); subsequent highway stretch aligns at r ~ 0.99. No constant temporal offset exists across the full 157-minute trip. GPS Doppler is mandatory ground truth.
